name: brand-admin-staff-role-scope-fix
title: Scope staff role list for Brand Admin
description: Authorize the staff role lookup through the active restaurant and BrandMembership scope, and request only the role fields the employee modal uses.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Implemented the scoped contract: roleList accepts restaurantId, authorizes through requireRestaurantPermission with staff.write, while unscoped legacy callers keep admin/manager/hr checks. The staff hook supplies the active restaurant, skips until scope is ready, uses cache-and-network, and requests only id/name/slug. Added a focused resolver test and re-fetched all changed files from main. Targeted Vitest, GraphQL validation, build, and browser replay were not run because the connector environment has no runnable checkout; GitHub reported no status checks or PR workflow runs.
